name: cpython-build-v0
note: Feasibility build matrix (D1, D3, D4 in docs/decisions.md). Every variant shares the source, toolchain, common configure options, and environment; only 'variants.<name>.configure' differs.

toolchain.linker: GNU ld (binutils-x86-64-linux-gnu, clang default for this target)

optimization_policy: CPython default OPT (-DNDEBUG -g -O3 -Wall); PGO and LTO disabled for every variant (cannot run PGO training when cross-compiling, and LTO is off to keep code layout comparable).

default.description: Specializing interpreter, default dispatch (computed gotos with clang).

jit.description: JIT-capable build, JIT off by default; enable at runtime with PYTHON_JIT=1.
